code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for i in range(h):
      for j in range(w):
        if grid[i][j]==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue
        stack=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); cells=[]
        while stack:
          a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
          for x,y in ((a-1,b),(a+1,b),(a,b-1),(a,b+1)):
            if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]!=0 and (x,y) not in seen:
              seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
        r0=min(a for a,b in cells); r1=max(a for a,b in cells); c0=min(b for a,b in cells); c1=max(b for a,b in cells)
        depths={}
        for a,b in cells:
          d=min(a-r0,r1-a,b-c0,c1-b)
          depths.setdefault(d,grid[a][b])
        ordered=[depths[d] for d in sorted(depths)]
        rev=list(reversed(ordered)); mp={v:rev[k] for k,v in enumerate(ordered)}
        for a,b in cells: out[a][b]=mp[grid[a][b]]
    return out
'''
